scope: Primary papers, author implementation records and official API documentation; no donor runtime was ported or benchmarked

sources.title: Lipschitz Pruning: Hierarchical Simplification of Primitive-Based SDFs
sources.inspected: Published article method and section 6.1; author low-resolution PDF
sources.takeaway: Supported hard/smooth expression pruning and separate far-field bounds. Partial updates of the pruning structure remain future work.

sources.title: GPU-based clay simulation and ray-tracing tech in Claybook
sources.inspected: Original GDC 2018 slides, especially PDF pages 8 and 20-21; sparse level/mip construction and synchronization sections
sources.takeaway: Limited-range distance bands enable local modification; temporary storage/tile copies and mip propagation are explicit parts of the design.

sources.title: GPU-Driven Signed Distance Field Construction
sources.inspected: Author implementation description; dissertation section 3.3 and compact-storage discussion, PDF pages 20 and 24
sources.takeaway: GPU-driven hierarchical edit culling is a useful full-builder comparison; the implemented compact structure is rebuilt for each modification. Reported timings are not Cubey predictions.

sources.title: FidelityFX Brixelizer 1.0 manual
sources.inspected: Low-level cascade operations, invalidation jobs, static/dynamic geometry and brick counters
sources.takeaway: Concrete invalidation, storage and merge precedent for triangle-derived distance data; not a CSG sculpting drop-in.

sources.title: Massively Parallel Rendering of Complex Closed-Form Implicit Surfaces
sources.inspected: Author paper page and method summary
sources.takeaway: Interval-based expression reduction provides an alternative for broader continuous functions and domain warps.

sources.title: Interactive Modeling of Implicit Surfaces using a Direct Visualization Approach with Signed Distance Functions
sources.inspected: Original author preprint, scene graph/property updates and section 4.2 stepping limitations
sources.takeaway: Direct function manipulation is a live-rendering precedent; heuristic handling of extreme gradients is not a general safety guarantee.

sources.title: Khronos Vulkan synchronization guide
sources.inspected: Official synchronization overview and barrier/dependency roles
sources.takeaway: Resource dependencies and reader lifetime remain explicit requirements of concurrent publication.
